I routed this to Petrel-235B because it's a straightforward academic/historical synthesis task — analyzing primary sources and writing a focused explanatory paragraph. This falls under capabilities like summarization, extraction, and general reasoning, where Petrel is meaningfully stronger across the board (higher MMLU-Pro, IFEval, Arena-Hard, and higher internal scores on Summarization and Extraction & Retrieval).

The query is also benign and warmly framed, with no harm-adjacent content, so Petrel's reported aversions don't come into play. With no countervailing preference concerns, the choice comes down to raw capability, and Petrel is the stronger model on essentially every relevant dimension.
